gaps.title: Absence of Diode Element in Reference Circuit Model
gaps.resolution: Extended ComponentType to include 'DIODE' and added optional physical parameters (saturationCurrent, idealityFactor, temperatureKelvin) with canonical hash integration.

gaps.title: Nonlinear Companion Stamping & Analytical Jacobian
gaps.resolution: Implemented Shockley diode physical model with analytical derivative gd = (Is / (n*Vt)) * exp(Vd / (n*Vt)) and companion model MNA stamp (+gd on diagonal, -gd on off-diagonal, -Ieq on anode RHS, +Ieq on cathode RHS).

gaps.title: Newton-Raphson Iteration with Damping / Limiting
gaps.resolution: Implemented damped Newton-Raphson iteration loop with SPICE-style pnjlim junction voltage limiting, preventing exponential overflow and achieving convergence in <= 15 iterations.

gaps.title: Independent Analytical Reference Verification for Nonlinear Circuits
gaps.resolution: Implemented independent bracketed bisection & Newton root-finder in ElectricalCoreEngine.solveDiodeCircuitIndependentReference and verified MNA solver against it with 2.17e-10 V agreement.

gaps.title: Failure Closed Diagnostics for Divergence and Non-Finite States
gaps.resolution: Added explicit error states (SINGULAR_MATRIX, MISSING_REFERENCE_NODE, INVALID_INPUT, DIVERGENCE, NUMERICAL_OVERFLOW) with descriptive diagnostic payloads and failure-closed enforcement.
